scope: Bounded C2 dev-only uniform global tau follow-up. No holdout/NN/Android/promotion; current live C1 full inference and its sources stay frozen.
hypothesis: Native labels can contain heterogeneous real clean-window vectors; a merge-only centroid refiner cannot split a mixed label. Cluster measured windows first, then project labels strictly within original predicted speech activity.
eigengap: Existing measured-centroid estimate diagnostic; applying reduction is separately explicit, not claimed to implement published NME-SC
invariants: No generated or padded embedding vectors
Native speech activity union preserved; overlap collapse reported
Actual saved ASR tokens/text order/raw WER unchanged
All8devcases mandatory; no per-file policy or expected K
Full original holdout and reserve separate regression checks before Android

dev_gates_unchanged.raw_wer: exact saved D words; primary raw still includes punctuation/case

decision: One prespecified global refinement of the coarse ERes030 average+small result around tau0.35. All21uniform values are run on all8dev; no per-case settings and no expansion after this bounded experiment.
stopping_rule: Run this finite21-value dev-only matrix once. Report the unchanged numeric joint gate and minimum DER. If none passes, stop; do not expand further or open holdout.
selection_before_any_holdout: Only complete8/8, all helper supported and literal/raw ASR invariance
Require native exact count>=7/8 and nativeDER0<=the unchanged fixed-V1.6+2pp bound
Among passing global profiles choose lower nativeDER0, then lower cpWERraw, then simpler/lower tau when tied
